note: T5 owns magnitudes, caps and stage order. This file stores only anchors and authored quanta. Magnitudes, caps, content_floor and the fused stack are generated. A stored cap is a build error (L71).

trait_relief_share_bps.why: Steady and Night Owl each relieve half of the named penalty: jitter width halves, night premium is multiplied by one half. Not an authored cap — the cap for jitter is this same quantum so L36 stays checkable

specialist_home_gain_bps.why: The only authored trait number: 1.0 → 1.15 on a home seat. Away is the symmetric mul remainder of the same quantum, not a second authored rate

witness_x.why: Non-commutativity witness base. Stepwise mulDiv of 3×1.5×1.3 depends on order; fused does not. Not a game rate

witness_a_bps.why: First witness multiplier 1.50. Pair with witness_b_bps. If a equals b the stepwise probe goes mute and L75 must fail

witness_b_bps.why: Second witness multiplier 1.30. Stepwise 3 then 1.5 then 1.3 floors to 5; reverse floors to 4; fused floors to 5

building_link_quantum_mult.why: Owner pick 1: baked link magnitude is node_effect_base_bps times this times steps. Doubles the quantum so a narrow linked city beats a wide unlinked one on dollars and percent

output_bps.why: Everything the written content can actually stack on one building. A clip below this throws away content the player already paid for

energy_cost_bps.why: One building-level step of energy growth. Same skeleton as the level curve

compute_cost_bps.why: Compute has no own growth curve: the energy curve is reused so a compute stack cannot outrun an energy stack of the same depth

build_cost_bps.why: One building-level step of cost growth. A discount stack must not erase the width-beats-depth curve

upgrade_speed_bps.why: One building-level step of build-time growth. Faster upgrades stay inside the same skeleton

xp_rate_bps.why: One agent-level step of XP growth. Handbook plus content must not skip a title

fragment_rate_bps.why: Paper twin of Capital output: the same growth step. Pool and claim window stay T6

population_conversion_bps.why: Retail Capital is still output. Same cap as workshop output so AAPL cannot outrun the production curve

idle_reduction_bps.why: Even an optimizer keeps residual_idle. Cap is 10000 minus that floor so two sources cannot reach 100 percent uptime

jitter_bps.why: Maximum jitter shrink is one Steady. Wider relief would zero the band and L36 would stop being checkable

agent_slots.why: slots_cap minus slots_start. City-level ladder already walks this span; the key must not overshoot the hard clip

offline_cap_hours.why: countable_unit times 1+2+3. Base 12 plus this cap is the named 18. Merge extra hours clip; the named 18 is not rewritten

fund_share_bps.why: Finance branch 500 times 1+2+3, plus one merge of the same key. Section 2.5 has no other weight cap in proportional payroll, so a second source must raise the cap or the merge would clip silently

overclock_output.why: Two quanta of output. Paid in energy on the same objective so slot-bound Overclock cannot print payback

overclock_energy.why: Energy delta is ceil of output times capex_trade_ratio, quantized up. Floor would improve net payback

frugal_output.why: Minus one quantum of output. The input relief is floored so Frugal cannot be a free lunch

frugal_energy.why: Energy relief floored against capex_trade_ratio. Ceil would over-save and beat the normalisation point

frugal_compute.why: Compute relief mirrors energy. Same floor, same quantum, no second authored rate

night_owl_energy.why: Multiplicative half of the night premium. Effective premium is not half because the premium itself is additive; named as R-T5-night-mul

steady_jitter.why: Remainder share equal to trait_relief. Width 500 becomes 250, band [9750, 10250]

specialist_home.why: Home seat 1.00 to 1.15. The only authored trait magnitude

specialist_away.why: Away seat is the symmetric remainder of the same 1500 bps: 0.85. Not a second authored rate

route_idle.why: Default logistician: two quanta of idle remainder. Local energy idle is the v1 job

stockpile_idle.why: Route plus two more quanta. Break-even idle versus Route is generated, not stored

stockpile_output.why: Minus one quantum of current output. The buffer is paid for; a zero penalty would make Stockpile dominate Route

train_xp.why: Two quanta of XP, same skeleton as Overclock output. Paid in compute on the same objective so Train cannot print titles

train_compute.why: Compute delta is ceil of XP quanta times capex_trade_ratio, quantized up. Energy curve reused so a compute stack cannot outrun energy

research_compute.why: Same paid-input ceil as Train. Alternative to Train on the same scientist: one objective, not both

derived.capex_trade_ratio_bps: 10000 plus energy_capex_share_bps, over energy_capex_share_bps, in bps. Not stored
derived.modifier_caps: thirteen caps from anchors: mul reciprocal pair, remainder complement, add structural
derived.modifier_rows: union of authored trait/objective rows plus research plus progression nodes, dividends and merges
derived.modifier_content_floor: per-key composition of rows that can legally coexist on one recipient
derived.modifier_stack_probe: free stack, paid stack, net_payback, bit width, non-commutativity witness
derived.night_owl_effective_premium_bps: additive premium after the multiplicative Night Owl row
derived.stockpile_breakeven_idle_bps: idle rate I-star at which Stockpile equals Route
derived.fused_division_count: keys with a cap plus one fused product; independent of row count
derived.worst_numerator_bits: bit length of the fused numerator at max caps and max base output
